title: Hennepin County Property Records (Minneapolis Metro)
description: Parcel records for every property in Hennepin County, MN (Minneapolis and 44 suburbs): owner and taxpayer as published, address, property type, market and taxable value, last sale price and date, taxes, delinquency year, year built, lot area and coordinates.
why: The county's own parcel file, one row per property, with the tax and sale fields listing sites don't show. Search by street, city, parcel ID or owner.
useCases: Investors and wholesalers pulling owner, value and last sale for a street or city
Title, lending and insurance teams verifying a parcel

street.title: Street name starts with
street.description: e.g. LYNDALE AVE S (the county writes streets in capitals)

delinquentOnly.title: Tax-delinquent only
delinquentOnly.description: Only parcels with a delinquent tax year.

limits: Hennepin County only. Owner and taxpayer names are the county's published fields.
